title: 2024 AMC 12A Problem 12
statement: The first three terms of a geometric sequence are the integers \(a,\) \(720,\) and \(b,\) where \(a\lt720\lt b.\) What is the sum of the digits of the least possible value of \(b?\)

solutions.text: Since the terms are geometric, \(720^2=ab,\) so \(ab=518400=2^8\cdot3^4\cdot5^2.\) Because \(b=\frac{518400}{a},\) minimizing \(b\) means finding the smallest divisor of \(518400\) greater than \(720.\) There is no divisor strictly between \(720\) and \(768:\) if its exponent of \(5\) is \(2,1,\) or \(0,\) then after dividing by \(25,5,\) or \(1,\) respectively, a number of the form \(2^i3^j\) would have to lie in \((28.8,30.72),\ (144,153.6),\) or \((720,768);\) the allowed powers \(i\le8,j\le4\) give none. Since \(768=2^8\cdot3\) is a divisor, it is the least possible \(b.\) Its paired divisor is \(a=\frac{518400}{768}=675,\) and the digit sum of \(b\) is \(7+6+8=21.\) Thus, the correct answer is E.
hints: To minimize \(b,\) take the largest divisor \(a\lt720\) of \(518400\)
